codeReview.summary: The feature adds the requested memo sections, license inventory, and publication gate scripts, but it contains blocking factual/evidence defects in adversarial-Q&A numeric claims and a gap in license-audit coverage rigor.

issues.description: The memo claims IQRs are 0.10–0.53 ms, but the cited benchmark artifact reports iqr_s values of 0.000148–0.000377 seconds (0.148–0.377 ms). This makes the numeric claim inaccurate and not evidence-faithful (see benchmarks/out/20260305T174325Z/sampling_validation.json lines 46, 55, 64, 73).
CLM-ADV-003 encodes the same incorrect IQR range (0.10-0.53 ms). The claim map therefore propagates an inaccurate numeric claim into the evidence index for publication review.

Runtime dependency coverage uses `cargo tree --depth 1`, which checks only direct dependencies and can miss un-attributed transitive runtime crates. The command result is also not validated via return code before passing coverage, which weakens the VAL-PUB-006 gate's completeness guarantee.

sharedStateObservations.observation: The worker relied on new publication validators (`publication/license_audit.py` and `publication/style_gate.py`), but these commands are not registered in `.factory/services.yaml`, so later workers/validators do not get standardized command aliases.
sharedStateObservations.evidence: Handoff verification.commandsRun includes `python3 publication/license_audit.py` and `python3 publication/style_gate.py --memo publication/ragas_blog_memo.md`; `.factory/services.yaml` contains `publication_gate`, `publication_reconcile`, and `publication_traceability` only.

sharedStateObservations.observation: Skill feedback requested explicitly ordering `license_inventory.json` creation before running `license_audit.py`, but the publication-worker skill does not encode that step, so the same sequencing confusion may recur.
sharedStateObservations.evidence: Handoff skillFeedback.suggestedChanges: 'publication-worker skill could mention that license_inventory.json should be created before license_audit.py'; `.factory/skills/publication-worker/SKILL.md` lacks this ordered prerequisite.

summary: Review failed due to blocking numeric-claim accuracy defects in the memo/claim map (CLM-ADV-003) despite otherwise substantial implementation coverage for regressions, limitations, licensing, and adversarial Q&A sections.
